menu:11036840:1.text: H-hey... why do you have Seven's ball?
menu:11036840:1.source_cn: 你、你手上为什么有小七的球？

say:1:1623155001:1.text: On Holt Street's stone pavement, there's a dog named Seven, waiting for his master who will never return.
say:1:1623155001:1.source_cn: 商业街石板路上有一只名叫小七的小狗，一直在原地等着永远...
say:1:1623155001:1.male: On Holt Street's stone pavement, there's a dog named Seven, waiting for his master who will never return.
say:1:1623155001:1.female: On Holt Street's stone pavement, there's a dog named Seven, waiting for his master who will never return.

say:2:1623155002:1.text: I always pause to check on him and keep him company. If you're in the area, could you do the same?
say:2:1623155002:1.source_cn: 我每次路过都会看它，和它聊聊天。你要是顺路，也顺便去看看吧。
say:2:1623155002:1.male: I always pause to check on him and keep him company. If you're in the area, could you do the same?
say:2:1623155002:1.female: I always pause to check on him and keep him company. If you're in the area, could you do the same?

say:0:1623156001:0.text: A lonely pup... This must be the one Professor Hepler meant.
say:0:1623156001:0.source_cn: 那只小狗，看上去好孤单……赫普老师说的应该就是它吧。
say:0:1623156001:0.male: A lonely pup... This must be the one Professor Hepler meant.
say:0:1623156001:0.female: A lonely pup... This must be the one Professor Hepler meant.

say:1:1623157001:1.text: You feel warm... like my master. I'd love to play... but I can't. I'm so sad.
say:1:1623157001:1.source_cn: 你身上有股暖暖的感觉，和主人一样……要是我现在没这么难...
say:1:1623157001:1.male: You feel warm... like my master. I'd love to play... but I can't. I'm so sad.
say:1:1623157001:1.female: You feel warm... like my master. I'd love to play... but I can't. I'm so sad.

say:2:1623157002:1.text: I miss him so much. He hasn't come to take me home in a long, long time.
say:2:1623157002:1.source_cn: 可是我……我太想我的主人了。他已经好久没来接我回家了。
say:2:1623157002:1.male: I miss him so much. He hasn't come to take me home in a long, long time.
say:2:1623157002:1.female: I miss him so much. He hasn't come to take me home in a long, long time.

choice_prompt:3:1623157002.text: I miss him so much. He hasn't come to take me home in a long, long time.
choice_prompt:3:1623157002.source_cn: 可是我……我太想我的主人了。他已经好久没来接我回家了。
choice_prompt:3:1623157002.male: I miss him so much. He hasn't come to take me home in a long, long time.
choice_prompt:3:1623157002.female: I miss him so much. He hasn't come to take me home in a long, long time.

say:4:1623157003:1.text: Yes! I have the ball he gave me! He loved playing fetch with me!
say:4:1623157003:1.source_cn: 有的！我有主人留给我的棍球！他以前最爱和我玩捡球游戏！
say:4:1623157003:1.male: Yes! I have the ball he gave me! He loved playing fetch with me!
say:4:1623157003:1.female: Yes! I have the ball he gave me! He loved playing fetch with me!

choice:3:0:1.text: I can help you find him.
choice:3:0:1.male: I can help you find him.
choice:3:0:1.female: I can help you find him.

choice:3:1:2.text: Got something of his I can track?
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 你有主人的信物吗？我会追踪术
choice:3:1:2.male: Got something of his I can track?
choice:3:1:2.female: Got something of his I can track?

say:0:1623158001:0.text: The scent... leads to the wheat fields?
say:0:1623158001:0.male: The scent... leads to the wheat fields?
say:0:1623158001:0.female: The scent... leads to the wheat fields?

say:0:1623159001:0.text: Strange, it's close, but no one's here... I'll try Ancestral Sense.
say:0:1623159001:0.source_cn: 奇怪，气息近在咫尺却不见踪影……用先祖感应试试看。
say:0:1623159001:0.male: Strange, it's close, but no one's here... I'll try Ancestral Sense.
say:0:1623159001:0.female: Strange, it's close, but no one's here... I'll try Ancestral Sense.

say:3:1623160002:0.text: Seven? I'm Puck Wilson. That's my boy! Where is he now? Is everything alright?
say:3:1623160002:0.source_cn: 小七……！真的是小七！我就是帕克威尔逊，是它的主人！那...
say:3:1623160002:0.male: Seven? I'm Puck Wilson. That's my boy! Where is he now? Is everything alright?
say:3:1623160002:0.female: Seven? I'm Puck Wilson. That's my boy! Where is he now? Is everything alright?

choice_prompt:4:1623160002.text: Seven? I'm Puck Wilson. That's my boy! Where is he now? Is everything alright?
choice_prompt:4:1623160002.source_cn: 小七……！真的是小七！我就是帕克威尔逊，是它的主人！那孩子……它现在在哪儿？它还好吗？
choice_prompt:4:1623160002.male: Seven? I'm Puck Wilson. That's my boy! Where is he now? Is everything alright?
choice_prompt:4:1623160002.female: Seven? I'm Puck Wilson. That's my boy! Where is he now? Is everything alright?

say:6:1623160005:1.text: Not long ago, I suffered a heart attack on my way home. I didn't make it.
say:6:1623160005:1.source_cn: 不久前，我在回家路上遭遇心脏疾病，最后没能挺过来……
say:6:1623160005:1.male: Not long ago, I suffered a heart attack on my way home. I didn't make it.
say:6:1623160005:1.female: Not long ago, I suffered a heart attack on my way home. I didn't make it.

say:7:1623160006:1.text: I'm afraid... I'll never see my dog again. Could you tell him everything?
say:7:1623160006:1.source_cn: 我恐怕……再也见不到小七了。能拜托你把这一切告诉它吗？
say:7:1623160006:1.male: I'm afraid... I'll never see my dog again. Could you tell him everything?
say:7:1623160006:1.female: I'm afraid... I'll never see my dog again. Could you tell him everything?

say:8:1623160007:1.text: He's a good, gentle boy. I hate the thought of hurting him, but... I can't keep him waiting forever.
say:8:1623160007:1.source_cn: 它是个善良的好孩子，我不忍心看它难过，但……我更不能再...
say:8:1623160007:1.male: He's a good, gentle boy. I hate the thought of hurting him, but... I can't keep him waiting forever.
say:8:1623160007:1.female: He's a good, gentle boy. I hate the thought of hurting him, but... I can't keep him waiting forever.

say:9:1623160008:1.text: Promise me he'll live a good life. That's the only way I can leave in peace.
say:9:1623160008:1.source_cn: 拜托你了，好心人。请一定让它好好活下去——这样，我也才...
say:9:1623160008:1.male: Promise me he'll live a good life. That's the only way I can leave in peace.
say:9:1623160008:1.female: Promise me he'll live a good life. That's the only way I can leave in peace.

choice:4:0:1.text: He's waiting for you on Holt Street.
choice:4:0:1.male: He's waiting for you on Holt Street.
choice:4:0:1.female: He's waiting for you on Holt Street.

say:11:1623160004:1.source_cn: 我也……无时无刻不在想它。

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 它很思念你，但一切还好

choice:2:0:1.text: Seven asked me to find his master.
choice:2:0:1.male: Seven asked me to find his master.
choice:2:0:1.female: Seven asked me to find his master.

say:0:1623161001:0.text: Looks like... I have to bring this news to Seven.
say:0:1623161001:0.source_cn: 看样子……我得把这个消息带给小七。
say:0:1623161001:0.male: Looks like... I have to bring this news to Seven.
say:0:1623161001:0.female: Looks like... I have to bring this news to Seven.

say:1:1623162001:1.text: You're back! You found my master, didn't you? Please tell me!
say:1:1623162001:1.source_cn: 你回来了，你一定找到了我的主人吧，对不对？求求你，快告...
say:1:1623162001:1.male: You're back! You found my master, didn't you? Please tell me!
say:1:1623162001:1.female: You're back! You found my master, didn't you? Please tell me!

choice_prompt:2:1623162001.text: You're back! You found my master, didn't you? Please tell me!
choice_prompt:2:1623162001.source_cn: 你回来了，你一定找到了我的主人吧，对不对？求求你，快告诉我吧！
choice_prompt:2:1623162001.male: You're back! You found my master, didn't you? Please tell me!
choice_prompt:2:1623162001.female: You're back! You found my master, didn't you? Please tell me!

say:3:1623162002:1.text: M-My master... Is he... really gone...?
say:3:1623162002:1.male: M-My master... Is he... really gone...?
say:3:1623162002:1.female: M-My master... Is he... really gone...?

say:4:1623162003:1.text: I told myself, "Just be good. Just wait." I thought that would bring him back...
say:4:1623162003:1.source_cn: 我明明一直在等他……我以为……只要我再乖一点，他就会回来……
say:4:1623162003:1.male: I told myself, "Just be good. Just wait." I thought that would bring him back...
say:4:1623162003:1.female: I told myself, "Just be good. Just wait." I thought that would bring him back...

choice_prompt:5:1623162003.text: I told myself, "Just be good. Just wait." I thought that would bring him back...
choice_prompt:5:1623162003.source_cn: 我明明一直在等他……我以为……只要我再乖一点，他就会回来……
choice_prompt:5:1623162003.male: I told myself, "Just be good. Just wait." I thought that would bring him back...
choice_prompt:5:1623162003.female: I told myself, "Just be good. Just wait." I thought that would bring him back...

say:6:1623162004:1.text: He always kept me safe... And even in his last moments... he was still worrying about me.
say:6:1623162004:1.source_cn: 主人他……从来不会让我我受苦。没想到就连最后的时刻……...
say:6:1623162004:1.male: He always kept me safe... And even in his last moments... he was still worrying about me.
say:6:1623162004:1.female: He always kept me safe... And even in his last moments... he was still worrying about me.

say:7:1623162005:1.text: I get it... I'll keep going... and carry his memories with me.
say:7:1623162005:1.source_cn: 我、我明白了。我得……替他继续往前走。
say:7:1623162005:1.male: I get it... I'll keep going... and carry his memories with me.
say:7:1623162005:1.female: I get it... I'll keep going... and carry his memories with me.

say:8:1623162006:1.text: As long as I'm here, he won't be forgotten.
say:8:1623162006:1.source_cn: 只要我还活着，主人就不会被遗忘。
say:8:1623162006:1.male: As long as I'm here, he won't be forgotten.
say:8:1623162006:1.female: As long as I'm here, he won't be forgotten.

say:9:1623162009:1.text: Thank you... for telling me the truth. And... thank you for staying with me through it.
say:9:1623162009:1.source_cn: 谢谢你……告诉我真相。也谢谢你……愿意陪我一起面对。
say:9:1623162009:1.male: Thank you... for telling me the truth. And... thank you for staying with me through it.
say:9:1623162009:1.female: Thank you... for telling me the truth. And... thank you for staying with me through it.

say:10:1623162010:1.text: I'll move forward... for my master... and for myself.
say:10:1623162010:1.source_cn: 我会好好活下去的……为了主人，也为了我自己。
say:10:1623162010:1.male: I'll move forward... for my master... and for myself.
say:10:1623162010:1.female: I'll move forward... for my master... and for myself.

choice:5:0:1.text: He wants you to live a good life.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 他希望你能好好活下去
choice:5:0:1.male: He wants you to live a good life.
choice:5:0:1.female: He wants you to live a good life.

say:12:1623162007:1.text: Thank you... I'm just... lost without him. I don't know how to do this alone.
say:12:1623162007:1.source_cn: 我知道……我只是……突然不知道该怎么习惯没有他的日子。
say:12:1623162007:1.male: Thank you... I'm just... lost without him. I don't know how to do this alone.
say:12:1623162007:1.female: Thank you... I'm just... lost without him. I don't know how to do this alone.

say:13:1623162008:1.text: I still hear him in my sleep... the footsteps I've been waiting for... Woof... Puck...
say:13:1623162008:1.source_cn: 我时常梦见他来接我的脚步声……汪呜……！主人……
say:13:1623162008:1.male: I still hear him in my sleep... the footsteps I've been waiting for... Woof... Puck...
say:13:1623162008:1.female: I still hear him in my sleep... the footsteps I've been waiting for... Woof... Puck...

say:0:1623163001:0.text: That's something, at least... Better talk to Professor Hepler.
say:0:1623163001:0.source_cn: 也算帮了小七吧……得回去和赫普老师聊聊。
say:0:1623163001:0.male: That's something, at least... Better talk to Professor Hepler.
say:0:1623163001:0.female: That's something, at least... Better talk to Professor Hepler.

say:1:1623164001:1.text: Did you check on Seven for me?
say:1:1623164001:1.source_cn: 你替我探望过小七了吗？
say:1:1623164001:1.male: Did you check on Seven for me?
say:1:1623164001:1.female: Did you check on Seven for me?

choice_prompt:2:1623164001.text: Did you check on Seven for me?
choice_prompt:2:1623164001.source_cn: 你替我探望过小七了吗？
choice_prompt:2:1623164001.male: Did you check on Seven for me?
choice_prompt:2:1623164001.female: Did you check on Seven for me?

say:3:1623164002:1.text: I see... Maybe knowing the truth is better than spending a lifetime trapped in fear and uncertainty.
say:3:1623164002:1.source_cn: 这样啊……它知道实情或许比终生活在焦虑而未知的等待中要...
say:3:1623164002:1.male: I see... Maybe knowing the truth is better than spending a lifetime trapped in fear and uncertainty.
say:3:1623164002:1.female: I see... Maybe knowing the truth is better than spending a lifetime trapped in fear and uncertainty.

say:4:1623164003:1.text: I only hope that loyal pup finds his way forward again.
say:4:1623164003:1.source_cn: 希望这只忠诚的小狗能重新找到自己未来的方向。
say:4:1623164003:1.male: I only hope that loyal pup finds his way forward again.
say:4:1623164003:1.female: I only hope that loyal pup finds his way forward again.
